data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), as it begins.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** unit of yours in an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)'s range, where you control that marker.

**Effect:** That objective marker becomes Corrupted. It stays under your control, even with no models of yours in range of it, until a turn begins or ends with your opponent controlling it. While a Corrupted objective marker is under your control, every part of the battlefield up to 6" from it is in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos).
